title: PageBuilder implementation mapping
summary: One typed PageBuilder for all 103 Russian routes, shared by full/isolated builds and composed through an explicit Document IR artifact.
current_behavior: BuildCommand calls one monolithic PortableSiteBuilder::build for full and --page modes.
Two full M0 builds and one isolated badge rebuild produced an identical 321-file manifest.
Single-page output is atomic by copying the complete previous build into a candidate directory.
All 103 selected Russian pages compile through the same PageBuilder into typed in-memory Document IR.
DeclarativePipeline::compose accepts the PageBuilder-owned RenderArtifact; raw trusted HTML and generated-page entry points are absent.
Full and isolated Badge builds call the same PageBuilder and are byte-identical; only the route set selected by PortableSiteBuilder differs.
M3.2 selects an isolated physical route before compiling pages or running component-catalog/declarative-example projectors, while preserving the same PageBuilder and final publication loop.
Alert full and isolated trees are byte-identical and an observer proves unrelated projections are not entered.
Batch 07 replaces the per-route target whitelist with one content/(ru/)?components/<slug>.md boundary, so every new physical component owner automatically uses the same typed PageBuilder.
M4.4 composes the PageBuilder document artifact with the declarative shell and records main_source=pagebuilder_document_ir for every route.
A full build writes one hash-bound disposable backlink projection; an isolated build reuses it for the selected route without compiling other pages, and full/single trees remain exact.
M5.4 binds receipts to the exact engine/dependency/Framework and production-input hashes, refuses stale-engine partial builds and proves a selected-page failure preserves the entire accepted output.
known_deviations: All 103 Russian routes are physical and proven through the same typed PageBuilder path.
The package declarative parser remains a non-public composition API/test contract; the public builder does not pass page Markdown through it.
InlineComponentRenderer delegates to the same SmartComponentGateway; shell SmartRenderer renders already-resolved layout plans and is not a second content gateway.
deletion_gates: Retire the remaining package declarative parser only under a separate public API compatibility decision.
Keep --page selection before compilation and prove it with observer tests.
Change the typed artifact seam only with full/single HTML, asset, metadata, heading, link and diagnostic parity.
